source.name: Cross-analysis of the full station CSV
source.description: 275,402 records from fixed source snapshots; aggregated by scripts/analyze_report.py. See chart notes for definitions and denominators.

metricDefinitions.stations: Station-level records, including restricted access, non-operating, and unknown-status stations.
metricDefinitions.points: Sum num_points; missing values count as 1 under the existing ETL convention.
metricDefinitions.fastShare: Records with maximum rated power ≥50 kW divided by all records in the group, including unknown power in the denominator.
metricDefinitions.ultraShare: Records with maximum rated power ≥150 kW divided by all records in the group.
metricDefinitions.top5Share: Records under the country’s five largest city names or original operator names divided by all national records, including missing names.
metricDefinitions.tagShare: Stations with the connector tag divided by all records in the power group; overlapping tags must not be added.
metricDefinitions.grid: Coordinates floored to 0.5° cells; only occupied cells are counted, and cell area varies with latitude.

source.name: Station-level spatial accessibility analysis
source.description: Public, operating stations. Non-fast origins include unknown power; fast targets have maximum rated power ≥50 kW. Cross-border targets allowed. Great-circle distances do not measure road distance, population coverage, or AFIR compliance. H3 r5 density uses actual cell area.

metricDefinitions.density100: Cell station records / actual H3 area × 100; all statuses and access conditions.
metricDefinitions.remote25: Public, operating origins with power <50 kW or unknown whose nearest public, operating ≥50 kW station is more than 25 km away by great-circle distance. The 25 km threshold is a screening scenario, not a legal requirement.
metricDefinitions.distance: WGS84 coordinates mapped to a unit sphere; KDTree nearest chord distances converted to great-circle distances using Earth’s mean radius of 6,371.0088 km; cross-border targets included.
metricDefinitions.germany: Cumulative valid charging points in current German records with commissioning years; not a reconstruction of the historical network. Missing years are not imputed and negative point counts are excluded.
